## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// A rectangular piece of a plane: (u, v) in Domain maps to the frame origin
// plus u along the frame's X axis and v along its Y axis.
type PlanarPatch
    implements IParametricSurface
{
    Frame: Frame3D;
    Domain: Bounds2D;
}

// A Coons patch: the surface blended from four boundary curves
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coons_patch). The curves must meet at the
// patch corners (Bottom/Top run in U, Left/Right run in V).
type CoonsPatch
    implements IParametricSurface
{
    Bottom: ICurve3D;
    Right: ICurve3D;
    Top: ICurve3D;
    Left: ICurve3D;
}

// A rectangular region of a sphere bounded by azimuth and inclination
// intervals (a latitude/longitude window).
type SphericalPatch
    implements IParametricSurface
{
    Sphere: Sphere;
    Azimuths: AngleInterval;
    Inclinations: AngleInterval;
}

//==
// # Trimmed, sampled, topological, and subdivision surfaces
//
// The surfaces that are not rectangular UV patches: a parametric surface
// restricted by trim loops, a sampled elevation field, the one-sided Mobius
// band, and the limit surface of a control mesh under a subdivision scheme.
// Evaluation of the Mobius band lives in `surfaces.library.plato`; the others
// are declarations only.

//==
// # Bounded and sampled surfaces

// A parametric surface restricted to a region of its UV domain: OuterLoop is
// a closed counter-clockwise polyline in UV space, and Holes are closed
// clockwise loops removed from it. Not a rectangular patch, so only ISurface.
type TrimmedSurface
    implements ISurface
{
    Base: IParametricSurface;
    OuterLoop: Polyline2D;
    Holes: Array<Polyline2D>;
}

// A sampled elevation surface: Heights holds regular samples over the ground
// rectangle Domain in the XY plane (columns along X, rows along Y), with
// bilinear interpolation between samples
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heightmap). Terrain and displacement data.
type HeightField
    implements IHeightFieldSurface
{
    Heights: Array2D<Number>;
    Domain: Bounds2D;
}

//==
// # Topological and subdivision surfaces

// A Mobius band: a strip of the given Width whose centerline circle of radius
// Radius lies in the frame's XY plane, twisted by HalfTwistCount half-turns
// over one lap (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/M%C3%B6bius_strip). An odd count
// yields the one-sided surface.
type MobiusStrip
    implements IParametricSurface
{
    Frame: Frame3D;
    Radius: Number;
    Width: Number;
    HalfTwistCount: Integer;
}

// The subdivision scheme applied to a control mesh
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Subdivision_surface).
type SubdivisionScheme = CatmullClark | Loop | DooSabin;

// The limit surface of a control mesh under a subdivision scheme, evaluated
// (or approximated) at the given refinement level
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Subdivision_surface).
type SubdivisionSurface
    implements ISurface, IDeformable3D
{
    ControlMesh: PolygonMesh3D;
    Scheme: SubdivisionScheme;
    Levels: Integer;
}
```
